title: Bee Removal in Van Nest, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in Van Nest, Bronx. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016 for fast service.
intro: Van Nest residents dealing with wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nests need fast, professional removal to protect their families and properties. The Best Pest Control NYC handles everything from paper nests in wall voids and soffits to carpenter bee galleries in wood trim and yellow jacket colonies in the ground. Our licensed technicians understand the unique challenges of stinging-insect control in Bronx neighborhoods and respond quickly to your call.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Van Nest and the greater Bronx for years with reliable, affordable bee removal services. Our licensed technicians use safe, proven methods to remove bees without harming your property, and we're available for same-day emergency service when you need us most.
localContext: Van Nest's mix of single-family homes, multi-family buildings, and local businesses along White Plains Road creates numerous opportunities for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets to establish nests in walls, attics, eaves, and soffits. The neighborhood's tree-lined residential streets and proximity to parks like Bronx Park make it particularly attractive to stinging insects seeking shelter in wall voids, under rooflines, and in ground burrows. Carpenter bees bore into wood trim and siding, while yellow jackets colonize attics and crawl spaces.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Van Nest?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet problem in Van Nest?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency nest removal services throughout Van Nest and the Bronx. In most cases, we can have our licensed technicians at your property within a few hours of your call, especially for urgent situations involving aggressive defenders or large nests near entryways.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Van Nest?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects do you remove in Van Nest?
faqs.answer: We remove wasp nests, hornet nests, yellow jacket colonies, carpenter bee galleries, and ground-nesting bee colonies common to the Bronx. Our team identifies the species, locates the nest or entry point, treats the colony, removes accessible nest material, and seals openings to prevent recolonization.
